decisive_items: plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, fragments of collagenous matrix
firm to hard without changes in the overlying skin
response.rationale: Multiple subcutaneous firm nodules with benign spindle cells and collagenous matrix favor fibromatosis over neurofibroma, which typically shows wavy nuclei and softer consistency. DFSP is excluded by lack of atypia and necrosis; lipomatosis and dermatofibroma are inconsistent with cytology and multiplicity.

rejected.why: Malignant features (atypia, necrosis) absent; cytology too bland for DFSP.
Lesions are firm, not soft; cytology shows spindle cells, not adipocytes.
Usually solitary and associated with epidermal changes; cytology lacks collagenous matrix prominence.
